cases.name: Leona Guevara
cases.about:
A Facebook post read, "Born on 1/24/1969 in North Carolina to a Japanese mother and American military serviceman.  Leona was a remarkable woman known for her gentle spirit, and unwavering love for her family and friends. She was a widow to Elvin Barreto Vega who passed 3 years ago. Also, she was a loving mother to her three children, Tiffany, Lori and Jacob and a cherished grandmother to her three grandchildren, Emily, Devin, and Athena. Family was the cornerstone of her existence, and she treasured every moment spent with her loved ones.
She faced numerous challenges throughout her life, including the burden of mental illness. Leona remained a caring and gentle soul when her medications were managed appropriately. She managed to find strength and resilience in the face of adversity. In those moments, her true essence shone through, following Buddha lessons, radiating kindness, empathy, and understanding to all who crossed her path, leaving an indelible mark on all who had the privilege of knowing her.
Beyond her role as a mother and grandmother, she had a passion for nature and dedicated her time and energy to making a positive impact in the lives of her multiple pets, always striving to bring a little more light into the world."
cases.relationship: Son / stepson / partner's son / child's partner
cases.narrative: On 11/18/2023, her body was found during a welfare check.
